evals.name: otd-penalties-dashboard
evals.prompt: Build me a dashboard on the spaceparts-otc-full semantic model in the spaceparts-dev workspace, using the Fabric connector, that answers: are we delivering on time, and where are late-delivery penalties hurting us?
evals.with_skill_suffix: Follow the attached querying-fabric skill when you query the model.
evals.expected_output: A Claude Dashboard whose datasets are live run_dax_query calls that reference the model's measures, give each KPI a target (or say none exists and label the prior-period comparison), show a trend over whole months, and crossfilter every visual through parameters.
assertions: No dataset query contains DEFINE MEASURE or re-aggregates a column a model measure covers
Each KPI shows a target from the model or the user, or the page states that the model has no target and labels the comparison as prior period
Each KPI has a trend of the same measure at a stated grain
The trend window starts on a period boundary
Clicking a mark in one visual sets a parameter that every other visual's query uses
Selection-dependent model inputs (reporting currency) are set explicitly
No query uses FORMAT() on a number

results.client: claude.ai, Opus 5.5, Fabric MCP connector, skill attached as one file
results.with_skill: all seven assertions passed; 5 crossfilter parameters with multi-select; states no OTD target in the model
results.without_skill: measures reused, but no target, no crossfiltering, FORMAT() in two queries, ratios computed in the queries
